classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Orientation-agnostic, cancel-safe timeline event drag and resize zone.
 * @description Extends `Neo.draggable.DragZone` (`super.dragStart` / `super.dragEnd` /
 * `super.onDragCancel`) and delegates all coordinate↔date conversion, snapping, and boundary clamping
 * to a `Neo.timeline.TimeAxis` (`axis`). Supports whole-bar move (`resizeEdge: null`) and edge
 * resizing (`resizeEdge: 'start' | 'end'`, with optional opposite-edge flip when
 * `enableResizingAcrossOppositeEdge: true`). Commits through `owner.commitTimelineEdit(...)` when present on
 * `owner` (or a single reactive `record.set(...)` + `store.doSort()` otherwise, never `setSilent`),
 * and restores original state without mutating `eventRecord` when `onDragCancel` or
 * `dragEnd({cancelled: true})` fires.
 * @class Neo.timeline.draggable.EventDragZone
 * @extends Neo.draggable.DragZone
 */
classData.summary: Orientation-agnostic, cancel-safe timeline event drag and resize zone.
classData.description: Extends Neo.draggable.DragZone (super.dragStart / super.dragEnd / super.onDragCancel) and delegates all coordinate↔date conversion, snapping, and boundary clamping to a Neo.timeline.TimeAxis (axis). Supports whole-bar move (resizeEdge: null) and edge resizing (resizeEdge: 'start' | 'end', with optional opposite-edge flip when enableResizingAcrossOppositeEdge: true). Commits through owner.commitTimelineEdit(...) when present on owner (or a single reactive record.set(...) + store.doSort() otherwise, never setSilent), and restores original state without mutating eventRecord when onDragCancel or dragEnd({cancelled: true}) fires.
classData.name: EventDragZone
